sourceTemplates: r6-* controllers plus narrow optional fixed engine selectors in QA bootstrap/runner

corrections.scope: QA only; before native engine-fault proof
corrections.problem: Initial main-only unprefixed profile ID regex refused valid prefixed work IDs.
corrections.fix: Root-reviewed selector-specific wg-/awg-/ovpn- plus 32 lowercase hex; main retains unprefixed 32 hex.

corrections.scope: QA only; initial OpenVPN engine-fault task stopped before Kill
corrections.problem: Protected rejected inherited TrustedInstaller maintenance rights on public installed app directories.
corrections.fix: Trust exact TrustedInstaller SID only for nonprivate exact application root or normalized descendants, keeping Vault443QA/private trust list and InheritOnly handling unchanged.
corrections.evidence: Read-only native ACL: app/openvpn directories owner BA, inherited TrustedInstaller FullControl; installed manifest/EXE owner BA, BU read only.

corrections.scope: QA syntax only; before execution/network mutation
corrections.problem: Native PS5 rejected catch immediately adjacent to exception type.
corrections.fix: Insert the required space in catch [Net.Sockets.SocketException].

corrections.scope: QA DNS family selection; native addresses restored but IPv6 resolver remained after IPv4-only setter
corrections.problem: Set-DnsClientServerAddress with one-family addresses retains static list of the other family.
corrections.fix: Use explicit family InputObject; change resets IPv4 then sets IPv6, restore resets IPv6 then sets original IPv4. Existing write-ahead intent and exact known-DNS ownership guard preserved.

corrections.scope: QA model mapping only; native matrix stopped at preflight before setup/fault
corrections.problem: Outline protocol label was incorrectly compared with Profile.Kind; real Kind is shadowsocks.
corrections.fix: Require exact Outline cache ID plus public kind=shadowsocks, transport=outline, source.kind=outline; protected selector requires private Outline object and transport=outline. Return family remains actual shadowsocks. Update fault/runner SHA pins.
